name: Árpás (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of red triangles along the top edge and a row of green triangles along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Árpás: a quartered red, green and white shield with a church, ears of grain, a fish and bars, above a scroll inscribed ÁRPÁS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
